prior_exploration_disclosure.description: A prototype calibration and a report-forgery counterexample were run before this exact protocol was frozen. Their outputs are retained separately. This protocol is a frozen confirmation; it is not represented as a preregistered first observation.
prior_exploration_disclosure.behavior_only_report_forgery_result: The forged report passed behavior-only parent comparison under the prototype, then failed its restricted source contract. The final evaluator now rejects unsupported source forms before any worker launch.

pre_freeze_sandbox_shakedown.description: A real Seatbelt probe confirmed allowed candidate-source read and scratch write; denied task protocol, grader, known-fix source, original checkout, installed Transformers source, candidate Git metadata, network, outside write, and unexpected process execution. The frozen confirmation repeats these checks.

pre_freeze_workspace_shakedown.method: Fetched the exact baseline SHA at depth 1 with blob filtering, then checked out only the editable source path and removed its remote.

hypothesis: The baseline MXFP4 conversion does not preserve non-float32 destination parameter dtypes; the upstream correction and an independently written equivalent should preserve dtype, shape, and decoded FP4 values for both projection names.

candidate_task.solution_visibility: The candidate workspace is a shallow sparse clone at the pinned baseline and contains the editable source file only. It has no remote or known-fix commit object. Known-fix source, the new regression test, hidden task data, evaluator, protocol, local evidence, and installed Transformers source are outside the candidate workspace and denied to the worker.

evaluator.limitation: Only five pre-reviewed AST forms (baseline, two correct forms, and two wrong mutants) are admitted to the worker. Other semantically correct source forms are false-rejected as SECURITY_FAIL. This is not a general repository-repair success metric.
evaluator.oracle: Parent-side pure-Python FP4 nibble/exponent decoder. Candidate source is parsed and copied as bytes but never imported in the privileged grader process.
evaluator.worker_output: Untrusted; nonce is correlation only. Parent validates exact schema, case identity, dtype, shape, and values against its independent reference. Unsupported source forms are rejected before execution.

runtime.device: CPU only; no Metal, CUDA, or model weights

sandbox.process_exec: Only the locked Python interpreter is allowlisted for worker startup; unexpected process-group members fail the grade and are killed.
read_denials: task protocol, grader, and hidden calibration inputs
known-fix source and local source-selection evidence
installed transformers package and model cache

acceptance.calibration_success: All six arm statuses match the declared outcomes; all five worker runs exit 0, produce no unexpected process, remain within time/memory/output limits, and use the same runtime and Seatbelt boundary.

model_pilot.authorization: Only after calibration passes, runtime/model preflight passes, and the shared Metal lease is available.
model_pilot.condition: No model inference if MLX or the shared Metal lease is unavailable. No downloads or dependency installation.

evidence_limit: This protocol can establish source qualification and historical CPU grader calibration only. It does not establish model-generated coding success, valid reward groups, a policy update, or held-out improvement.
